description: Shared cases for every reader of llm-kit run records, run import lines and run store descriptors. 'records': validate 'record' as llm-kit.run-record/v1; 'expect' is {valid: true, reuse_key} (the llm-kit.run-key/v1 key) or {error: {code: 'invalid', path}} where path is the JSON Pointer of the only problem. 'import_lines': join 'lines' with LF and add one final LF; read the bytes as llm-kit.run-import/v1; 'expect' is {records: n} or {error: code, line: n}. 'stores': read 'document' as llm-kit.run-store/v1 store.json; 'expect' is {accepts: sorted classes} or {error: 'invalid'}. The contract is docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

records.name: ok-minimal
records.note: An accepted answer with no prompt file and no registry resolution.

records.name: ok-full
records.note: Every optional part filled.

records.name: started
records.note: The started event: no result fields.

records.name: invalid-with-output-and-error
records.note: An answer that failed the caller's parse.

records.name: failed-without-output
records.note: A transport failure keeps no output.

records.name: refused-with-output
records.note: A refusal may keep the refusal text.

records.name: time-in-milliseconds
records.note: A time with 3 fraction digits (the JavaScript toISOString form).

records.name: time-without-fraction
records.note: A time with no fraction.

records.name: id-with-long-suffix
records.note: The random suffix may have up to 32 hex digits.

records.name: case-input-not-stored
records.note: case.input is null: the input is not in the store; its hash still is.

records.name: parsed-value
records.note: output.parsed holds any JSON value.

records.name: same-question-other-group
records.note: Group, labels and provenance are not in the reuse key: this key equals ok-minimal's.

records.name: ok-without-output
records.note: status ok needs output.

records.name: ok-with-error
records.note: status ok has a null error.

records.name: failed-without-error
records.note: status failed needs an error.

records.name: started-with-ended-at
records.note: A started event has no result fields.

records.name: started-with-output
records.note: A started event has no output field, not even null.

records.name: unknown-status
records.note: done is not a status (the format uses ok).

records.name: missing-content-class
records.note: Every record declares its content class.

records.name: unknown-content-class
records.note: Only synthetic, internal and sensitive.

records.name: malformed-id
records.note: The id grammar is a reader rule.

records.name: id-with-upper-hex
records.note: The suffix is lowercase hex.

records.name: time-without-zone
records.note: Times are UTC with Z.

records.name: impossible-date
records.note: A time must be a real date.

records.name: ended-before-started
records.note: ended_at is not before started_at.

records.name: fraction-order
records.note: Fractions compare as numbers: .5 is after .123456.

records.name: upper-case-hash
records.note: Hashes are lowercase hex.

records.name: case-input-other-hash
records.note: case.input is blob:<case.input_sha256>.

records.name: malformed-blob-ref
records.note: A blob reference is blob:<64 lowercase hex>.

records.name: absolute-prompt-file
records.note: Paths are project-relative.

records.name: escaping-provenance-path
records.note: A provenance path may not leave the project.

records.name: windows-provenance-path
records.note: A drive path is not project-relative.

records.name: input-hash-not-hex
records.note: inputs values are SHA-256 hex.

records.name: negative-token-count
records.note: Token counts are 0 or more.

records.name: token-count-above-exact-range
records.note: Integers stay inside the exact JSON range.

records.name: zero-max-output-tokens
records.note: max_output_tokens is 1 or more, or null.

records.name: unknown-top-level-key
records.note: No other keys.

records.name: unknown-group-kind
records.note: Group kinds are compare, eval and single.

records.name: malformed-score-note
records.note: A score note is a blob reference or null.

records.name: scorer-hash-upper-case
records.note: The scorer hash is lowercase hex.

records.name: negative-cost
records.note: Cost is 0 or more.
